title: FrosstBound Chronicles .
author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
selftext: Here is the in game recording of solo developing deckbuilder game of mine . What you guys think ? i mostly implemented card , event mechanics and modifiers . Barely got any visual  or VFX . Also need help for some animation of my some assets. Currently  only implemented 1 Classs . But i got full mechanics of my other 4 classes Which is Alchemist , Pandora , Loom Weaver and Parasite

comments.author: caster
comments.body: Really nice work. Your visuals are excellent.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: Bro you can't make that fancy loading menu screen and then the rest of the game looks like it was made for Windows95.. Like you have to change all of your UI windows to fit the theme, it's such a jarring transition going from that main screen to the next few with just monochrome coloring.

comments.author: Kanzes
comments.body: you have to rework those UI. the visuals and animation are ok i think. Cards need some distinct differentiator tho, it looks samey, try making the cards more simple

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: All cards will have their artwork different. Now i have only 2 different for attack and defend cards

comments.author: Antique_Pair_140
comments.body: Sincerly hard to judge but as i like strategy i love map, events and idea like traveling fight, but for now battle was a bit empty there is no effects like hiting you or hiting him, sounds, Im cleless on such card play so that is all i can help ...

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: im glad you liked the MAP ! i didnt add any vfx or sound yet . I will work on them later
